authoring.reasoningSummary: Offline concept simulation: Considered fragrance gifting without implied bundles. Five invented source signals and two illustrative indices support a carefully limited product-grounded four-shot EN/AR script and a planned pre-produced media/never-sent delivery path.
assumptions: An understated gifting narrative could resonate with a hypothetical UAE luxury-fragrance audience.
Paper-card graphics are merely a layout device and do not imply a physical product insert.
The visual identity can stay consistent with the Lavish HTML reference without lifestyle stock imagery.
limitations: These are invented sample signals and not observed seasonal or retail demand.
No gifting service, gift wrapping, store offer or gift-set SKU is verified.
Arabic copy needs native review and brand review.
MP4 and poster are not supplied.
All platform inputs, plotted indices, execution events and delivery records are fabricated for a labelled Mock POC, not collected, rendered or sent.
Final video and poster are not present; asset bytes/hash/rights are null/pending so the immutable runnable Schema intentionally fails until customer media handoff.
30 fps video metadata is a target specification, not a measured file property.
Simulated delivery records depict counterfactual demo outcomes only; no real email was sent.
